description_en: You can call the Tongyi Xiaomi CCAI-Conversation Analysis AIO application using the Message protocol format to obtain conversation summaries, extract key information, and generate quality inspection and conversation analysis results. The application supports HTTP calls to provide responses. You can use either the standard HTTP or HTTP Server-Sent Events (SSE) protocol
description_zh: 支持以Message协议格式调用通义晓蜜CCAI-对话分析AIO应用获取对话摘要、关键信息抽取、质检结果、对话分析结果，应用调用支持 HTTP 调用来完成客户的响应，目前提供普通 HTTP 和 HTTP SSE 两种协议，您可根据自己的需求自行选择
kebab_example: aliyun contactcenterai run-completion-message --workspace-id llm-ik000000RVYCKzt --app-id 097d65c9c7004f8dad2b454850ac232b --messages Role=user Content=如Role=system_,Content=You_are_a_helpful_assistant._Role=user_,_Content=请阅读以下对话内容，按照要求执行指令任务。 --model-code tyxmTurbo --stream false --response-format-type example-string --region cn-hangzhou
name: RunCompletionMessage

element_fields.example:
如Role=system ,Content=You are a helpful assistant.
Role=user , Content=请阅读以下对话内容，按照要求执行指令任务。
element_fields.name: content

element_fields.help_en: The role in the conversation. Valid values: \`user\` (customer), \`agent\` (customer service representative), \`system\` (system message), and \`function\` (function call)
element_fields.help_zh: （通话角色） user-客户 agent-客服 system-系统消息 function-函数
element_fields.name: role

parameters.help_en: The list of messages for the model request
parameters.name: messages

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable SSE responses. The default value is \`false\`
parameters.help_zh: true则会开启 SSE 响应，默认false
parameters.name: stream
